text: Who's in here after hours? Amara some evenings, gone by ten. Ben, for his test runs. David, some nights; he says it's quieter than his office.
style: Cryptography research lead in her mid-forties. Speak with a consistent educated Irish (Dublin) accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Clear, mid-range pitch; measured, precise pace. Sharp, protective of her team and impatient with sloppy reasoning.
